model: t.e2e = prove + verify + depth x rtt + bytes / bw; throughput(N) = min(N / t.e2e, 1 / prove, 1 / verify); N_sat = ceil(t.e2e / prove)

designs.name: A-CPU Goldilocks^3 (GKR+logUp+Ligero)
designs.notes: memory = peak RSS (the committed trace + codeword store + sumcheck state)

designs.name: A-CPU BabyBear^6 (GKR+logUp+Ligero)
designs.hardware: AMD EPYC 9654 (vy-cpu2, 12 of 32 threads, shared with b-lookup and checker-min)
designs.source: backends/gkr/README.md r20260922-065112-d687; depth as Goldilocks (same lookup chain)

designs.name: A-GPU re-priced (4090 fused SIMT sumcheck, BabyBear^6)
designs.source: reports/fused_sumcheck_4090.md: 0.866 s/batch (graphed x96, conservative; 0.641 s at census widths); ledger a-fused 2.15e7
designs.verify_note: CPU BabyBear verifier 45 s used (no GPU verifier measured): dominates the serial e2e; a GPU verifier or deferred checks would change this row
designs.notes: memory = phase-1 tables 15.6 GB (PROTOCOL.md 12.4) + codeword store 45,809 rows x 16,384 x 4 B = 3.0 GB; one batch per 24 GB card

designs.name: A-GPU re-priced (4090 fused SIMT) with a hypothetical 1 s verifier
designs.source: as the row above; verifier 1 s ASSUMED (no such verifier exists) to expose the depth x RTT term
designs.verify_note: hypothetical: a GPU or 45x-parallel verifier; the row isolates the network term from the CPU verifier's 45 s
designs.notes: same memory per batch as the row above

designs.name: A-GPU re-priced (H100 packed sumcheck, model)
designs.source: ledger a-packed: A re-priced w/ packed sumcheck, model, 1.07e7 -> 0.43 s/batch

designs.name: B-CPU AIR (Plonky3 uni-stark FRI, Goldilocks^2)
designs.notes: t.total includes 24.2 s witness generation; memory = peak RSS (trace 2^19 x 2,844 + LDE + Merkle)

designs.name: B-Ligero GPU re-priced (4090, BabyBear, helper columns)
designs.source: reports/b_measured_4090.md: 259 ms/batch, 95% measured; peak device memory 20.6 GiB (codeword store kept)
designs.verify_note: 0.4 s assumed (the CPU FRI verifier's range 0.15-0.4 s; the Ligero verifier re-encodes t = 192 columns of 310,602 rows)
designs.notes: bytes: t = 192 opened columns x 310,602 rows x 4 B = 238 MB + tests (ZK_CONSTRUCTION.md 1); depth 3 interactive (4 with step 0)

designs.name: SP1 core (Fiat-Shamir, one VU per proof)
designs.notes: depth 1: the proof is one message; the transferable baseline; peak GPU memory 9.9 GB per proof

designs.name: C QuickSilver CPU (dietmc F61p, 2^-36 sensitivity point)
designs.source: ledger c-vole: 4096 VUs dietmc F61p 0.408 s/VU; 8.58 MB/VU P->V
designs.verify_note: verifier ~ prover (the designated verifier checks every MAC: 38.4 s vs 37.9 s in the F384p run)
designs.notes: 2^-36 statistical bound (F61p, r = 1): a sensitivity point, not the operating point; the 2^-128-class F384p run is 4.74 s/VU and 54.4 MB/VU

designs.name: C QuickSilver GPU model (tensor.md 3.05e6 overhead)
designs.notes: bandwidth-bound: 35 GB per batch against 0.12 s of prover compute
